description: This file defines a React functional component named ArticleDetail that displays details of an article fetched from an API based on URL parameters. It uses React hooks like useEffect and useState, along with react-router-dom's useParams to obtain URL parameters. The component fetches a list of articles, finds the one matching the provided ID, and renders either a message if the article is not found or an ArticleCard component with the article data.

methods.name: ArticleDetail()
methods.description: React functional component that displays detailed information of a single article based on URL parameter 'id'. It fetches articles list on mount and updates display accordingly.
